scope: Existing project harmonized tasks; not an assertion about every native annotation

native_encoding.value: zero background; all nonzero foreground; native vocabularies heterogeneous

native_resolution.value: variable; development summary ranges in each domain, not per-sample geometry

sample_id.value: manifest sample_id; not a patient ID

native_label_values.qualification: observed development signatures, not new inspection

patient_source_ids.value: not in canonical manifests/frozen C1; historical grouping sidecar recorded but not opened or adopted

native_label_values.qualification: union of observed development signatures of RGB JPEG masks, first channel reduced; intensity values are not classes
observed examples, not claimed exhaustive; nonzero values do not define semantic subclasses

patient_source_ids.value: patient_id required by frozen C1 plan; case_id may be unavailable

acquisition_subgroups.value: ROI or FULL_FIELD inferred from directory semantics; UNKNOWN otherwise

category_metadata.qualification: subgroup metadata, not pixel-level semantic classes

domain_fields_status: VERIFIED_FROM_SOURCE except fields explicitly marked otherwise

inferred_not_confirmed.field: BUSI sidecar patient semantics and availability for evaluation
inferred_not_confirmed.value: historical table records a grouping sidecar; not evidence that canonical C1 records contain verified patient IDs; no protocol change

development_inventory_scope: Phase19 TRAIN and VAL inventory only. Resolution summaries are not paired minimum/maximum image shapes. Native label unions are observed intensities, not semantic subclasses.
restriction: No native images, masks, TEST or ROUTER_HOLDOUT records were opened for ontology construction.
